  let s := orbit (n + 1);
  s.1 = 2 * (orbit n).1 + 3 * (orbit n).2 ∧ s.2 = 1 * (orbit n).1 + 2 * (orbit n).2 := by
  simp_all only [orbit]

theorem reusable_fact (n : Nat) :
  (orbit n).1 * (orbit n).2 = (orbit n).2 * (orbit n).1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [orbit]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp [orbit, ih]
    ring
